findings.title: Gate goldens blessed with the advance gate DISABLED — run_demo never threads demo.advance_gate_on into the live/bless path
findings.evidence: run_demo's cfg literal sets name/use_fixture/qos_fixture/growth_on/session but NOT advance_gate_on (only load_demo_replay:688 sets it); demo_apply_setup:635 applies state.advance_gate_enabled = cfg.advance_gate_on (false). Empirical: `harness replay advance_fire goldens/advance_fire.log.bin` -> 'FIRST DIVERGENCE at tick 600' (the gate-fire tick); a gate-off replay matches the manifest bit-for-bit.
findings.detail: All 3 gate-demo manifests (advance_fire, advance_block_sla, advance_block_legacy) pin gate-OFF runs: era stays 2 for all 1400 ticks, no Era_Advanced, no Era_Advance_Blocked. The demos' header comments, the stories-v2 status fold ('goldens advance_fire.dem (conditions met -> fires)... each block branch T1-pinned'), and the PR body are false in the blessed artifacts. Violates deliverable 3 / acceptance: 'Golden: T1 of the advance (conditions met -> fires); T1 of each block branch'. The standalone ODN-11 replay gate is red on all 3 demos as shipped; harness run's verify_replay uses run_demo's gate-off cfg for both halves so CI gate 4 passes hollow. New-demo T2 pixels (60000ms captures) are equally gate-off renders.
findings.recommended_fix: Add advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on to run_demo's cfg literal (run.odin:269) and re-bless the 3 gate goldens (acceptance lens verified the one-line fix produces the tick-600 fire + bit-for-bit replay).

findings.title: drift-check flip classes are vacuous — temp-arena clobbering of lpath makes every flip replay fail 'cannot read', counted as a rejection
findings.evidence: lpath := log_path(name) (fmt.tprintf temp string, loop top) is invalidated by replay_hashes' per-tick free_all(context.temp_allocator) in the mutation loop and overwritten by the last mutation's tmp tprintf; the flip then reads '/tmp/pp-drift-<name>-.' (lpath's original 30-char length over the tmp path's memory) -> accepted=false -> ok := !accepted || ... -> vacuous 'rejected (OK)'. Confirmed by instrumented probe (Perkins + acceptance lens independently).
findings.detail: The advance_gate_flip class — new in 6.2, the shipped guard the Perkins briefing explicitly says to 'verify it bites' — never re-sims anything: it passes vacuously on all 3 gate demos. An honest flip on the actual gate-off manifests would have FAILED (gate-off re-sim matches gate-off manifest), i.e. this vacuity is the mechanism that let B1 ship green. The pre-existing growth_flip (5.1) has the identical defect (same probe result on terminal_types/growth/node_health). Leftover /tmp/pp-drift-*-bad_era.bin corroborate (os.remove(tmp) also clobbered).
findings.recommended_fix: Give the flip a stable log path: re-call log_path(name) at the flip sites (or strings.clone lpath with context.allocator at loop top); then the flip honestly re-sims the blessed log gate-off. Audit the same lifetime bug for growth_flip.

findings.title: Era_Advance_Blocked enter-edge dedup (anti-chatter) never pinned — block tests assert boolean saw_* only, never event counts
findings.evidence: testing.expect(t, saw_sla, ...) / saw_legacy / saw_crisis — the only count assertion is blocks==0 on the healthy path; era.odin:303 documents 'emit on the ENTER of a blocked state (or a reason change), deduped — never every tick'.
findings.detail: An emit-every-tick regression passes every unit test. With the goldens currently hollow (B1), the block-event stream has no pin anywhere; even after re-bless, reason-transition re-emits (Crisis->Legacy->Sla) are unpinned (no transition demo/unit test).
findings.recommended_fix: Assert exactly one Era_Advance_Blocked per blocked episode in the SLA/legacy tests; add a reason-transition case asserting one event per distinct reason.

findings.title: Scripted Cmd_Era_Advance while the gate is BLOCKED is untested — the latch-held-while-blocked path is unexercised
findings.evidence: test_advance_gate_scripted_request_still_gated uses gate_fixture (healthy); the only other scripted test runs gate-disabled. The PR claims 'a scripted advance still works, gated the same way' and the code comments 'the latch holds' while blocked.
findings.detail: No test latches a scripted request into a blocked gate and asserts it does NOT fire, the latch survives, and it fires after the block clears.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a test scripting Cmd_Era_Advance with an SLA or legacy block active; assert era stays 2 while blocked, latch survives, fires after recovery.

findings.title: milestone_window_ticks validator cap (10000) rejects the documented full-game tuning (12 min @ 20 Hz = 14400 ticks)
findings.evidence: if b.advance.milestone_window_ticks < 1 || b.advance.milestone_window_ticks > 10000 { ... } — vs data/balance.json's own advance _comment: 'the GDD full-game assumption is ~8-12 min/era'; 12*60*20 = 14400 > 10000.
findings.detail: The upper half of the documented design range fails catalog load. The MVP value 600 is unaffected; the landmine arms when full-game tuning lands.
findings.recommended_fix: Raise the cap to cover the documented range (e.g. 20000) or reconcile the documented range with the ring-memory rationale; keep the foot-gun rationale explicit.

findings.title: E15 crisis test captures fire_tick but never asserts it — the 'fire lands after crisis resolves' ordering is unpinned (dead variable)
findings.evidence: fire_tick: u64 = max(u64) — assigned in the event loop, never read; no resolve_tick captured; the comment claims 'the fire must land AFTER the crisis resolves (E14/E15: never mid-crisis)'.
findings.detail: The ordering is structurally guaranteed by era_gate_block (crisis -> return), but the test's claimed pin does not exist and fire_tick is dead code.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture resolve_tick and assert fire_tick > resolve_tick (and fire_tick != max(u64)), or delete fire_tick and soften the comment.

findings.title: Stand-in legacy predicate over-blocks era 1 (narrow is 'legacy' in the era that introduces it) — documented 6.3 seam, named for the record
